title: The specified Koszul completion unit at nilpotent generators is invertible
statement: For any scheme X, commutative ring B, finite list b:Fin r→B, positive a with b_j^a=0 for every j, and arbitrary unbounded complex C of B-module sheaves on X.ProEt, localization of the specified map koszulCompletionUnitComplex is an isomorphism. The construction is that of def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-koszul-completion. No K-flatness or Noetherian hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Proof, order 1328, sentences three through seven

proof.text: Use the graded split-proconstant calculation: the tensor units have degreewise retractions natural in the tower, and each a-step transition factors through them. This identifies the constant cone C with the degreewise limit.

source.place: Proof, order 1328, sentences three through seven

proof.text: On each graded product split off the constant part. The shift on its complement has a-th power zero. A finite geometric sum gives a section for one-minus-shift there, while finite partial sums give a section on the constant product. Thus one-minus-shift is degreewise epic, and its kernel is C. The kernel-to-shifted-cone quasi-isomorphism has exactly the components of koszulCompletionUnitComplex; localize it.
